description: Read the simulated world state of a session: chat messages, the computer's own redstone (redstone.outputs per side, inputs, bundledOutputs), virtual inventory contents, peripheral state (speakers, detectors, ME/RS bridges, QIO), the turtle and its block world; with the vhcctweaks addon also token balances, the transaction ledger, the host and who is authenticated. delta:true returns only what changed since the previous sim call (changed values as {from,to}, new chat and ledger entries as `appended`), which is usually a few lines.

delta.description: Return only what changed since the previous call.

name: craftos_sim_state
